title: Minute Out In It: Steamboat Geyser Eruption
place: Norris Geyser Basin, Yellowstone National Park, Wyoming
notes: Low-angle view of the water column shooting up against a blue sky. The cut avoids the title card, the timestamp overlay, the burned-in '[people cheering]' caption (around 164-167 s) and the crowd shots (around 48 s and 108-118 s in the original). Original audio kept: eruption roar, possibly faint crowd noise, so muting is recommended. 1080p source. No people visible in the cut.
fact_en: Steamboat Geyser is the world's tallest active geyser; its major eruptions shoot water more than 300 feet (91 m).
